text: Shared TextLineLayout and a common NativeParagraph line engine now support exact Unicode-opportunity word wrapping. New explicit shaping context windows preserve global clusters while preventing joining across line edges; original shapeRange keeps full paragraph context. Candidate lines use full-source bidi/script context, L1/L2 per line, existing supplied-face fallback and shared call/byte/glyph budgets. All 9 wrapping and 8 existing paragraph tests pass, including Arabic boundary forms, bidi whitespace, cross-wrap brackets, NBSP/WJ/ZWSP, grapheme protection, overflow, closure and candidate/line/global-run limits. Full JVM/Native/font/Unicode verification pending.
